text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Today is the start of the "Summer Training 
Camp." Hishi Amazon takes charge as the 
dorm leader, keeping everyone together and 
looking after her overly freewheeling 
juniors.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Amidst the lively atmosphere, her 
scorching summer was about to begin!
